Its four heads take E26 bulbs. The four bulbs that came with it are SANSI C21GL-GE26-10W (120 V AC, 60 Hz, 0.2 A, 10 W; made February 2025), the same bulb as your six spare 10 W bulbs, so any of them can go in any head. The clamp is marked "Max: 4 x 10 W": never put a bigger bulb in a head. The bulbs are not dimmable, are rated for damp locations, and must not be used in totally enclosed fixtures (the open heads are fine).
